      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-auto-shutdown

[中文说明](#中文说明) · Windows only · works with DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.1

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds **one switch in Settings → General**: turn it on, and
the computer shuts itself down when the next conversation finishes — with a native
Windows dialog that can cancel the pending shutdown with a single click.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown
```

Or install a prebuilt tarball from a GitHub Release:

```powershell
dsh plugin add https://github.com/873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown/releases/latest/download/dsh-auto-shutdown.tgz
```

Then restart the Harness (Host restart is enough) and look for the plugin entry
`auto-shutdown` in the profile.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → General** and find **“Power off after the conversation finishes”**.
2. Turn it on.
3. Finish a conversation: when that turn ends, the plugin
   - resets the switch to off (it is a one-shot trigger, never re-armed by a reboot),
   - schedules `shutdown.exe /s /t <delaySeconds>`,
   - opens a desktop countdown dialog.

The dialog offers:

| Button | Result |
| --- | --- |
| **Cancel shutdown** | runs `shutdown /a`; the machine stays up |
| **Keep shutdown** / close / countdown reaching zero | the planned shutdown happens |

You can also cancel from any terminal with `shutdown /a`.

## Configuration

All three fields are editable live from the Settings page and the Plugins page — no restart.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | The switch. It is set back to `false` right before a shutdown is scheduled, so the trigger fires exactly once. |
| `delaySeconds` | `60` | Shutdown delay in seconds (5–86400). The dialog countdown mirrors it. |
| `popup` | `true` | Whether to show the cancel dialog at all. |

## Safety notes

- No administrator rights are required; `shutdown /s /t` is available to the logged-in user.
- Only a **root** conversation can trigger it: turns of subagents/teammates are ignored, and
  if another agent is still running the trigger waits for the next turn boundary.
- `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN=1` in the Host environment logs the two commands instead of
  running them — useful for testing the wiring.
- `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_POPUP_LOG=<file>` makes the dialog append its user actions to a file.
- The dialog only ever runs `shutdown /a`; it never schedules anything.

## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): listens to the `agent/turn-stopping` event, filters to root
  agents, latches once, writes `enabled = false` through the Settings service, then spawns
  `shutdown.exe`. It is a validated Cordis plugin (`Config` with volatile fields), so the
  switch is a real Settings document write.
- **Cancel dialog** (`lib/popup.js` + `assets/notify.ps1`): a detached Windows PowerShell 5.1
  WinForms window with a countdown (always-on-top when ≤ 120 s). Its copy is passed as argv and
  the script itself stays ASCII-only, so a non-UTF-8 code page cannot mangle Chinese text.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`): registers one `settings.general.item` row that renders the
  switch from `ctx.configForms`, i.e. from the Host's own configuration form.

## Development

```powershell
# schemastery is only resolvable through a junction when testing outside the profile
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery `
  -Target "C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Roaming\DSH\data\versions\<version>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery"

$env:DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN = '1'
node test-dry-run.mjs        # host logic: filtering, disarm, argv, one-shot
node tests/popup-test.mjs    # real window: self-close, cancel path, failure path, shutdown /a
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules
```

`tests/popup-test.mjs` uses `-SimulateCancel -TestCancelCommand 'cmd /c exit 0'` style test
switches, so it never touches a real pending shutdown.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host plugin: event trigger, disarm, spawn `shutdown.exe` |
| `lib/popup.js` | Cancel-dialog argv builder + launch (shared with the tests) |
| `lib/client.js` | Settings row with the switch |
| `assets/notify.ps1` | Windows PowerShell/WinForms countdown dialog |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the Host entry `auto-shutdown` |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin list title/description |

## 中文说明

Windows 专用。为 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个**设置开关**：打开后，**下一次对话完成时自动关机**，
并在关机前弹出一个原生 Windows 对话框，点一下即可取消本次关机。

### 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown
```

安装后重启 Harness（重启 Host 即可），插件条目为 `auto-shutdown`。

### 使用

1. 设置 → **通用** → 找到「**对话完成后自动关机**」，打开开关。
2. 正常结束一次对话，此时插件会：
   - 把开关自动复位为关闭（只触发一次，重启后不会突然关机）；
   - 执行 `shutdown.exe /s /t <延迟>`；
   - 弹出倒计时对话框。
3. 对话框里点「**取消关机**」→ 执行 `shutdown /a`，电脑保持开机；点「**继续关机**」/ 直接关窗 /
   倒计时归零 → 按计划关机。也可以在终端随时执行 `shutdown /a` 取消。

### 配置项（均可在设置里实时修改，无需重启）

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | 开关。排定关机前会自动写回 `false`，保证只触发一次。 |
| `delaySeconds` | `60` | 关机延迟秒数（5–86400），也是弹窗倒计时时长。 |
| `popup` | `true` | 是否弹出取消窗口。 |

### 注意事项

- 不需要管理员权限。
- 只有**根会话**能触发：子 Agent / 团队成员回合会被忽略；若还有其它 Agent 在运行，会推迟到下一次回合边界。
- 设 `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN=1` 可只打日志、不真的关机；设 `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_POPUP_LOG=<文件>`
  可记录弹窗里的用户操作，便于排障。
- 弹窗只会执行 `shutdown /a`，不会自己排定任何关机。

### 许可

MIT

      "path": "lib/index.js",
      "content": "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
import { schedulePopup } from './popup.js'

/** Cordis plugin name (also the Settings namespace of this entry). */
export const name = 'auto-shutdown'

/** Host services required by the one-shot shutdown trigger. */
export const inject = ['agents', 'settings']

/**
 * Validated configuration. Every field is volatile: the Settings row and the
 * Plugins page can edit them while the Host keeps running, without a reload.
 * `enabled` is reset to false right before a shutdown is scheduled, so the
 * plugin fires exactly once and never re-arms itself after a reboot.
 */
export const Config = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean().default(false).volatile(),
  delaySeconds: z.number().step(1).min(5).max(86400).default(60).volatile(),
  popup: z.boolean().default(true).volatile(),
})

const COMMENT = 'DeepSeek Harness: conversation finished'

/** Test switch: log the commands instead of scheduling a real shutdown. */
export function isDryRun() {
  const flag = process.env.DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN
  return flag === '1' || flag === 'true'
}

/** Absolute path to shutdown.exe so PATH differences cannot redirect it. */
export function shutdownExecutable() {
  const root = process.env.SystemRoot || process.env.windir
  return root ? `${root}\\System32\\shutdown.exe` : 'shutdown'
}

/** Schedule the Windows shutdown, or only log it in dry-run mode. */
function scheduleShutdown(logger, delaySeconds, dryRun) {
  const args = ['/s', '/t', String(delaySeconds), '/c', COMMENT]
  const command = `"${shutdownExecutable()}" ${args.join(' ')}`
  if (dryRun) {
    logger.warn(`auto-shutdown: dry run, would execute ${command}`)
    return false
  }
  try {
    const child = spawn(shutdownExecutable(), args, {
      detached: true,
      stdio: 'ignore',
      windowsHide: true,
    })
    child.on('error', (error) => {
      logger.error(`auto-shutdown: could not start shutdown: ${error.message}`)
    })
    child.unref()
    logger.info(`auto-shutdown: executed ${command}`)
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error(`auto-shutdown: could not start shutdown: ${error.message}`)
    return false
  }
}

/**
 * Host half: arm on `agent/turn-stopping` for a root agent once enabled, reset
 * the switch, schedule the shutdown after the configured delay, then open the
 * cancel dialog so a single click can abort it with `shutdown /a`.
 * @param ctx - Host plugin context.
 * @param config - validated configuration.
 */
export function apply(ctx, config) {
  const logger = ctx.logger
  let fired = false

  /** Only a user-facing root conversation may arm the shutdown, never a teammate. */
  function isRootAgent(agent) {
    return ctx.agents.roots().some((root) => root.id === agent.id)
  }

  /** Another live agent still running means this is not the last conversation. */
  function anotherAgentRunning(self) {
    return ctx.agents.list().some((agent) => agent.id !== self.id && agent.status === 'running')
  }

  /** Persist enabled=false so a reboot cannot re-arm the one-shot trigger. */
  async function disarm() {
    try {
      await ctx.settings.mutate(name, [{ op: 'set', path: ['enabled'], value: false }])
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn(`auto-shutdown: could not reset enabled: ${error.message}`)
    }
  }

  // A listener that never objects, so it must not hold the turn boundary open:
  // latch the fact synchronously, then do the write and the spawns off the event.
  ctx.on('agent/turn-stopping', ({ agent }) => {
    if (fired || !config.enabled.get()) return
    if (!isRootAgent(agent)) return
    if (anotherAgentRunning(agent)) return
    fired = true
    const delaySeconds = Math.max(5, Math.round(config.delaySeconds.get()))
    const dryRun = isDryRun()
    const popup = config.popup.get() === true
    void (async () => {
      await disarm()
      scheduleShutdown(logger, delaySeconds, dryRun)
      if (popup) schedulePopup(logger, delaySeconds, dryRun)
    })().catch((error) => {
      logger.error(`auto-shutdown: failed to arm the shutdown: ${error.message}`)
    })
  })
}
"

      "path": "lib/popup.js",
      "content": "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

/** Desktop dialog copy; kept here so the PowerShell script stays ASCII-only. */
export const POPUP_COPY = {
  TitleText: 'DSH 自动关机',
  HeadlineFormat: '电脑将在 {0} 秒后自动关机',
  BodyText: '对话已完成。点击「取消关机」可中止本次关机，点击「继续关机」保持计划。',
  CancelLabel: '取消关机',
  KeepLabel: '继续关机',
  CancelledText: '已发送取消指令，电脑将保持开机。',
  CancelFailedFormat: '取消失败（代码 {0}）。',
  ClosedText: '保持计划，将按计划关机。',
}

/** Absolute path of the dialog script shipped next to this module. */
export const POPUP_SCRIPT = fileURLToPath(new URL('../assets/notify.ps1', import.meta.url))

/** Windows PowerShell 5.1 is the only host guaranteed to ship WinForms. */
export function popupExecutable() {
  const root = process.env.SystemRoot || process.env.windir
  return root
    ? `${root}\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe`
    : 'powershell.exe'
}

/** Optional file the dialog appends its user actions to, for troubleshooting. */
export function popupLogPath() {
  const path = process.env.DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_POPUP_LOG
  return path ? path.trim() : ''
}

/**
 * Build the exact argv of the cancel dialog process: the production copy plus
 * the countdown. Keeping this pure makes the wiring testable.
 * @param delaySeconds - shutdown delay shown by the countdown.
 * @param logPath - optional action log file written by the dialog.
 */
export function buildPopupArgs(delaySeconds, logPath = '') {
  const args = [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-NonInteractive',
    '-STA',
    '-ExecutionPolicy',
    'Bypass',
    '-WindowStyle',
    'Hidden',
    '-File',
    POPUP_SCRIPT,
    '-Seconds',
    String(delaySeconds),
  ]
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(POPUP_COPY)) {
    args.push(`-${key}`, value)
  }
  if (logPath) {
    args.push('-LogPath', logPath)
  }
  return args
}

/**
 * Open the desktop dialog that lets the user abort the scheduled shutdown.
 * The dialog only runs `shutdown /a`; it never schedules anything itself.
 * @param logger - plugin logger.
 * @param delaySeconds - countdown shown by the dialog.
 * @param dryRun - log the command without opening a window.
 */
export function schedulePopup(logger, delaySeconds, dryRun) {
  const args = buildPopupArgs(delaySeconds, popupLogPath())
  const command = `"${popupExecutable()}" ${args.join(' ')}`
  if (dryRun) {
    logger.warn(`auto-shutdown: dry run, would show the cancel dialog (${command})`)
    return
  }
  try {
    const child = spawn(popupExecutable(), args, {
      detached: true,
      stdio: 'ignore',
      windowsHide: true,
    })
    child.on('error', (error) => {
      logger.error(`auto-shutdown: could not show the cancel dialog: ${error.message}`)
    })
    child.unref()
    logger.info('auto-shutdown: cancel dialog shown; clicking it runs shutdown /a')
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error(`auto-shutdown: could not show the cancel dialog: ${error.message}`)
  }
}
"

    {
      "path": "assets/notify.ps1",
      "content": "# DSH auto-shutdown desktop dialog.
#
# Shows a Windows message box with a visible countdown. Clicking the cancel
# button runs the cancel command (by default `shutdown /a`), which aborts the
# shutdown already scheduled by the Host plugin. The dialog runs as its own
# process: it never blocks the DSH Host, and it disappears with the session
# shutdown if nobody clicks it.
#
# All user-visible copy is passed in as parameters so this file stays ASCII and
# parseable by Windows PowerShell 5.1 regardless of the file encoding.
#
# Test hooks (never used by the plugin itself):
#   -SelfTest        show the dialog, close it after ~2.2s, log the result
#   -SimulateCancel  click the cancel button after ~1.2s, using
#                    -TestCancelCommand instead of the real cancel command
param(
  [int]$Seconds = 60,
  [string]$TitleText = 'Auto shutdown',
  [string]$HeadlineFormat = '{0} seconds until automatic shutdown',
  [string]$BodyText = 'The conversation finished. Click the cancel button to stop the shutdown.',
  [string]$CancelLabel = 'Cancel shutdown',
  [string]$KeepLabel = 'Keep shutdown',
  [string]$CancelledText = 'Cancel requested. The computer stays on.',
  [string]$CancelFailedFormat = 'Cancel failed (code {0}).',
  [string]$ClosedText = 'Kept. The computer shuts down as planned.',
  [string]$CancelCommand = 'shutdown /a',
  [string]$LogPath = '',
  [switch]$SelfTest,
  [switch]$SimulateCancel,
  [string]$TestCancelCommand = 'cmd /c exit 0'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-ProbeLog([string]$Text) {
  if ($LogPath -ne '') {
    try {
      Add-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value (('{0:o} {1}' -f (Get-Date), $Text)) -Encoding UTF8
    } catch {
      # observation only
    }
  }
}

trap {
  Write-ProbeLog ('FATAL: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
  exit 1
}

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::EnableVisualStyles()

[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::add_ThreadException({
    param($sender, $eventArgs)
    Write-ProbeLog ('THREAD EXCEPTION: ' + $eventArgs.Exception.Message)
  })

$script:remaining = [Math]::Max(1, $Seconds)
$script:cancelHandled = $false

$form = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
$form.Text = $TitleText
$form.FormBorderStyle = [System.Windows.Forms.FormBorderStyle]::FixedDialog
$form.StartPosition = [System.Windows.Forms.FormStartPosition]::CenterScreen
$form.MaximizeBox = $false
$form.MinimizeBox = $false
$form.ShowIcon = $false
$form.ClientSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(496, 224)
$form.BackColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::White
$form.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Microsoft YaHei UI', 9.75)
if ($Seconds -le 120) {
  $form.TopMost = $true
}

$headline = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$headline.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(26, 22)
$headline.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(444, 34)
$headline.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Microsoft YaHei UI', 14, [System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Bold)
$headline.Text = ($HeadlineFormat -f $script:remaining)
$form.Controls.Add($headline)

$body = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$body.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(28, 66)
$body.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(440, 56)
$body.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(68, 68, 68)
$body.Text = $BodyText
$form.Controls.Add($body)

$status = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$status.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(28, 124)
$status.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(440, 26)
$status.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(68, 68, 68)
$status.Text = ''
$form.Controls.Add($status)

$cancelButton = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button
$cancelButton.Text = $CancelLabel
$cancelButton.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(236, 170)
$cancelButton.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(132, 34)
$cancelButton.DialogResult = [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::None
$form.Controls.Add($cancelButton)

$keepButton = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button
$keepButton.Text = $KeepLabel
$keepButton.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(376, 170)
$keepButton.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(96, 34)
$keepButton.DialogResult = [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::None
$form.Controls.Add($keepButton)

$form.AcceptButton = $cancelButton
$form.CancelButton = $keepButton

$countdownTimer = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer
$countdownTimer.Interval = 1000
$countdownTimer.add_Tick({
    $script:remaining = [Math]::Max(0, $script:remaining - 1)
    $headline.Text = ($HeadlineFormat -f $script:remaining)
    if ($script:remaining -le 0) {
      $countdownTimer.Stop()
      $form.Close()
    }
  })

$closeTimer = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer
$closeTimer.Interval = 1800
$closeTimer.add_Tick({
    $closeTimer.Stop()
    $form.Close()
  })

$selfTestTimer = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer
$selfTestTimer.Interval = 2200
$selfTestTimer.add_Tick({
    $selfTestTimer.Stop()
    Write-ProbeLog 'selftest closing'
    $countdownTimer.Stop()
    $form.Close()
  })

function Invoke-Cancel {
  if ($script:cancelHandled) { return }
  $script:cancelHandled = $true
  Write-ProbeLog 'cancel clicked'
  $command = $CancelCommand
  if ($SimulateCancel -and $TestCancelCommand -ne '') {
    $command = $TestCancelCommand
  }
  Write-ProbeLog ('running: ' + $command)
  try {
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $env:ComSpec -ArgumentList @('/c', $command) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -Wait
    Write-ProbeLog ('exit code: ' + $process.ExitCode)
    if ($process.ExitCode -eq 0) {
      $status.Text = $CancelledText
    } else {
      $status.Text = ($CancelFailedFormat -f $process.ExitCode)
    }
  } catch {
    Write-ProbeLog ('cancel failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    $status.Text = ($CancelFailedFormat -f $_.Exception.Message)
  }
  $countdownTimer.Stop()
  $headline.Text = $TitleText
  $closeTimer.Start()
}

$cancelButton.Add_Click({ Invoke-Cancel })

$keepButton.Add_Click({
    Write-ProbeLog 'keep clicked'
    $countdownTimer.Stop()
    $status.Text = $ClosedText
    $closeTimer.Start()
  })

$form.Add_Shown({
    Write-ProbeLog ('form shown; seconds=' + $script:remaining)
    $form.Activate()
    $countdownTimer.Start()
    if ($SelfTest) {
      $selfTestTimer.Start()
    }
    if ($SimulateCancel) {
      $countdownTimer.Stop()
      $headline.Text = ($HeadlineFormat -f $script:remaining)
      $cancelButton.PerformClick()
    }
  })

$form.Add_FormClosing({
    Write-ProbeLog ('form closing; cancelHandled=' + $script:cancelHandled)
  })

$form.Add_FormClosed({
    $countdownTimer.Stop()
    $closeTimer.Stop()
    $selfTestTimer.Stop()
    Write-ProbeLog 'form closed'
  })

[void]$form.ShowDialog()
Write-ProbeLog 'exit'
exit 0
"

    {
      "path": "lib/client.js",
      "content": "window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: '@873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown',
  factory(require) {
    var module = { exports: {} }
    var exports = module.exports
    Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' })

    const React = require('react')
    const h = React.createElement

    /** Locale namespace of the Settings row copy. */
    const locale = 'settings.autoShutdown'
    /** Host plugin entry id; doubles as its Settings namespace and row id. */
    const namespace = 'auto-shutdown'

    const en = {
      title: 'Power off after the conversation finishes',
      description:
        'Once enabled, this computer shuts down when the current conversation completes. The default delay is 60 seconds. To prevent an accidental shutdown, a "cancel shutdown" dialog appears at that point so you can cancel it.',
      armed: 'Armed — this computer will shut down when the conversation finishes.',
      saved: 'Preference saved',
      failed: 'Could not save preference',
    }

    const zh = {
      title: '对话完成后自动关机',
      description:
        '开启后，本次对话完成时自动关闭电脑。默认 60 秒后关机。为防止误触，届时会弹出「取消关机」窗口，可取消本次关机；',
      armed: '已开启：本次对话结束后将自动关机。',
